completion_evidence: PR #1 merged: main b54fe2e -> 08f5275. npm run verify fully green on a fresh clone. ROOT CAUSE of the pre-merge UNSTABLE CI, which was NOT a rewrite: check:immutable two-dot-diffs the branch against origin/main, so the three Events main gained AFTER this branch forked read as deletions from the branch. Proven with `git merge-base --is-ancestor` -- the commit adding 2026-08-06-unsolveable-mathematics-program-started.json is not an ancestor of the branch. Merging main resolved it. One real follow-on fix was required (commit 2118817): the V37 launch assertion in scripts/check-site.mjs pinned counts.events===29 and active_initiatives===1; the merged registry holds 32 Events and 4 active initiatives. Updated to the merged truth, still pinning exact numbers.
